Title: Azure Search Document Cracking Image Extraction Resource GUID name change

Body.Content:
Effective July 1, 2019, the Azure Search Document Cracking Image Extraction meter’s (also known as resource GUID) name will change. You will need to modify billing routines that rely on the meter’s naming attributes.

See the table below for name change details.

Resource GUID

Service Name

Service Type

New Resource Name

Region Name

Old Product name (EA Portal name)

New Product name (EA Portal name)

Old EA Material Description

New EA Material Description
